text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - Jan Slota, Chairman of the ultra-right Slovak National Party (SNS), a junior member in the governing coalition, said his party would not support Sovakia's entry to western structures.

- Slota rejected critical remarks by U.S. ambassador to Slovakia Ralph Johnson on the lack of democratic development in Slovakia saying ambassadors cannot lay down conditions for integration to western structures for Slovakia.
- The EBRD's has so far approved 17 projects of financial support to Slovakia totalling some 425 million ECU, of which funds worth some 278 million ECU have already been drawn.

SME - Foreign Minister Pavol Hamzik said he did not see any reason why the ministry should react to recent public speeches by "some of the many ambassadors to Bratislava". He was commenting on recent criticism expressed by EU and U.S. Ambassadors both of whom voiced concerns over the pace of democratic reforms.
- The SNS has accused deputies of the ethnic Hungarian coalition of "indirectly threatening Slovak state integrity" by their participation in a Budapest conference on ethnic Hungarians living abroad.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - A commission consisting of the finance ministry, the Bratislava Stock Exchange and security traders will present by the end of this year a new strategy for the future development of the capital market.

- Production in the pharmaceutical industry totalled 4.8 billion crowns in the first eight months of the year, some six percent more than over the same period last year. Exports totalled 2.9 billion crowns, five percent less than in 1995, due to a surplus on its main foreign markets.
PRAVDA - Slovakia is considering accepting an unspecified number of Russian military helicopters as part repayment of Russia's debt to Slovakia inherited from the communist period.
